articles.title: Mayville Engineering Company Announces Third Quarter 2026 Results

articles.summary: Mayville Engineering Company (NYSE: MEC) (the “Company” or “MEC”), a leading value-added provider of design, prototyping and manufacturing solutions serving diverse end markets, today announced results for the three months ended September 30, 2026. THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS (All comparisons versus the prior-year period) Net sales of $170.4 million, or +18.1% y/y Net income of $0.4 million, or $0.02 per diluted share; Non-GAAP Adjusted Diluted EPS of $0.15 Adjusted EBITDA of $17.0 million Adjusted EBITDA margin of 10.0% of net sales Ratio of net debt to trailing twelve-month Adjusted EBITDA of 2.9x 1 as of September 30, 2026 Secured approximately $45 million in Datacenter Critical Power project awards 1 Trailing twelve-month Adjusted EBITDA is calculated per the Company’s current Credit Agreement MANAGEMENT COMMENTARY “Our third quarter results were in line with our expectations and reflected strong demand as project volumes continued to accelerate within our Datacenter
